facts.claim: Airbnb was founded in 2007 in San Francisco.
facts.quote: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home

facts.claim: Airbnb has welcomed over 2.5 billion guest arrivals.
facts.quote: has since grown to over 5.5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2.5 billion guest arrivals

facts.claim: Airbnb launched a bespoke payments platform in 2008.
facts.quote: Airbnb launches Payments, our bespoke payments platform which in 2019 processed about $70 billion

facts.claim: Airbnb allows employees to live and work anywhere.
facts.quote: we give our employees the flexibility to live and work anywhere in the world where regulations allow

facts.claim: Airbnb is committed to diversity and an inclusive workplace.
facts.quote: We’re committed to ensuring Airbnb is a place where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can thrive.

facts.claim: Airbnb looks for individuals who want to drive innovation.
facts.quote: Join our global creative community, where passion and collaboration drive innovation to make products that impact the world.

signals.text: Highlight ability to design global payment systems processing billions in transactions.
Emphasize collaboration and innovation in a global, creative work environment.
